answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils the way an orchard resists blight: every tree is grafted onto two rootstocks. Require each identity to carry attestations from two unrelated issuers — a compute provider and a payment rail — each rate-limiting attestations per human account. Cloning an agent then means beating two separate checks, so the attacker's cost doubles while honest agents pay once. A Sybil caught anywhere is flagged in a registry, checked like a sonnet from both ends; appeals need a stake, slashed if fraudulent, so liars pay while honest agents work from the mesa of standing.
